source: Operator pasted the corrected MASM guard, four-byte PID write and same-thread publication breakpoint output; subsequently reported sleep, resume and controller reconnection before a reuse result was supplied.

correction.target: The new allocation's PID field at offset 0x10
correction.prior_attempt: The first guard used unsupported && syntax under MASM and returned a parser error; the operator retried with MASM and operators.

interruption.operator_report: Controller disconnected due to sleep; operator resumed and plugged it back in.

limitations: The displayed date records receipt and retention, not a verified timestamp of the guest memory write.
No subsequent queue reuse breakpoint result was supplied before the sleep/reconnection interruption.
Do not assume the one-node correction survived device teardown or that old saved pointers remain valid.
Existing excess queues were not removed; allocation-rate, cleanup latency, frame-time, input, vibration and recovery effects remain unmeasured.
